## Overview On ROCm, apply the Qwen3.5 attention output gate (`attn * sigmoid(gate)`) inside the `ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON` decode, in AITER's split-K reduce, instead of a separate kernel per full-attention layer. The model now hands the gate to the attention layer; backends that cannot fuse it get `out * sigmoid(gate)` from `Attention.forward`, so their graphs do not change. Stacked on #65248; only the last commit belongs to this PR. Requires [ROCm/aiter#6842](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6842), which dispatches to Triton reduce kernel instead of HIP when output_gate is supplied as an argument. The AITER PR also includes a fix for zero-length sequences: without it, padded CUDA-graph decode rows come out of the gated reduce as NaN. ## Claims - 16 fewer kernels per decode step on Qwen3.8-27B (one per full-attention layer): the Inductor `mul`/`sigmoid` kernel is gone and the gate copy is not needed. - Serving, against #65248: within ±0.5% total tok/s and mean TPOT at c4–c64 (+0.4% tok/s at c64); GSM8K unchanged. - No change for other backends or models: without backend support, `Attention.forward` applies the gate itself. Before: After: ## Validation ### Op level: one 64-token decode step MI355X, Qwen3.8-27B BF16 TP1, 1024×64 c64 serving trace: | | Kernels per step | Gate | Decode step (ms) | |--|--:|--|--:| | #65248 | 850 | HIP PS reduce (4.65 µs), then Inductor `mul(sigmoid)` kernel (4.86 µs) | 17.66 | | This PR | 834 | AITER's Triton `paged_attention_decode_ps_reduce_kernel` (4.67 µs) | 17.61 | ### Serving MI355X, Qwen3.8-27B BF16, TP1, 1024×1024, greedy runs. Both arms use the same image, container and AITER build and the shuffle KV-cache layout; only the vLLM commit differs. | Arm | vLLM | AITER | |--|--|--| | Before | #65248 | vLLM's pin + #6842 | | After | #65248 + this PR | vLLM's pin + #6842 | | Concurrency | Total tok/s Before | After | Δ | Mean TPOT (ms) Before | After | Δ | Mean TTFT (ms) Before | After | Δ | |--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | 4 | 676.2 | 676.3 | +0.0% | 11.66 | 11.65 | −0.0% | 190.5 | 192.4 | +1.0% | | 16 | 2,362.0 | 2,354.7 | −0.3% | 12.96 | 13.04 | +0.6% | 608.1 | 573.2 | −5.7% | | 32 | 3,859.5 | 3,878.3 | +0.5% | 15.65 | 15.57 | −0.5% | 965.1 | 967.3 | +0.2% | | 64 | 6,049.4 | 6,075.0 | +0.4% | 19.94 | 19.88 | −0.3% | 1,256.8 | 1,230.8 | −2.1% | | Arm | GSM8K (5-shot, n = 1319) | |--|--:| | Before | 0.7301 | | After | 0.7248 | ### Reproduction ```bash # Server VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --kv-cache-dtype auto \ --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --async-scheduling -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True \ --language-model-only # Bench vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --endpoint /v1/completions \ --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --random-range-ratio 0.0 \ --ignore-eos --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 --num-prompts $((10 * C)) --max-concurrency $C # GSM8K lm_eval --model local-completions \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False \ --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 # Unit test pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon_output_gate.py ``` ### Tests - `tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon_output_gate.py` (new, ROCm only, needs AITER with `output_gate`): 32/32 pass. A compiled gated-attention model against an eager `attn * sigmoid(gate)` reference, for supported and unsupported backends, flat and per-head gates, 1–128 tokens; checks the `sigmoid` count and that the attention op carries `output_gate` only when supported. ## Details - `Attention.forward(..., output_gate=None)`: when the impl supports it (`fused_output_gate_supported()`, read once at construction), the gate goes to the attention op as `[T, H, D]`; otherwise `Attention.forward` returns `out * sigmoid(gate)`. - `unified_attention_with_output` gains `output_gate`, passed to `impl.forward` only when set. The 8 `auto_functionalized(ATTN_OP, ...)` patterns in `attn_quant_fusion.py` name `output_gate=None`, because the pattern matcher compares kwargs exactly. - `AttentionImplBase.fused_output_gate_supported()` defaults to False. - `ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON` supports it when a layer takes the gluon decode and AITER has `output_gate`. Single-token decodes get the gate in the split-K reduce (launches with more than one split); every other token gets `mul_(sigmoid(gate))` in the impl. - `Qwen3NextAttention._project_qkv_gate(..., flat_gate=True)`: the attention path passes `flat_gate=False`, so the gate stays a `[T, H, D]` view of `qkv` and needs no copy kernel. The NVIDIA `fused_sigmoid_gate_mul` path and the Qwen4Exp callers keep the flat gate. The fused path is ROCm `ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON` only; every other backend applies the gate in `Attention.forward`. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON: which layers it decodes on gluon, and when the Qwen3.5
+config hook selects it."""
+
+import importlib
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="ROCm-specific tests"
+)
+
+
+def _reload_envs():
+    import vllm.envs as envs
+
+    return importlib.reload(envs)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def aiter_env(monkeypatch):
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+
+    def apply(shuffle: bool) -> None:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA", "1")
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT", "1" if shuffle else "0")
+        _reload_envs()
+        rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+
+    yield apply
+    monkeypatch.undo()
+    _reload_envs()
+    rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("num_heads", "num_kv_heads", "head_size", "kv_cache_dtype", "shuffle", "expected"),
+    [
+        (24, 4, 256, "auto", True, True),
+        (24, 4, 256, "auto", False, False),
+        (24, 4, 256, "fp8", True, False),
+        (16, 2, 256, "auto", True, False),
+        (32, 8, 128, "auto", True, False),
+    ],
+    ids=["qwen38", "plain-kv", "fp8-kv", "gqa-8", "head-128"],
+)
+def test_pa_gluon_supports(
+    num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_size, kv_cache_dtype, shuffle, expected, aiter_env
+):
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa_gluon import pa_gluon_supports
+
+    aiter_env(shuffle)
+    assert (
+        pa_gluon_supports(num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_size, kv_cache_dtype)
+        is expected
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("backend", "heads", "kv_cache_dtype", "shuffle", "expected"),
+    [
+        (None, (24, 4), "auto", True, "ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON"),
+        (None, (24, 4), "auto", False, None),
+        ("ROCM_ATTN", (24, 4), "auto", True, "ROCM_ATTN"),
+        (None, (16, 2), "auto", True, None),
+        (None, (24, 4), "fp8", True, None),
+    ],
+    ids=["qwen38", "plain-kv", "user-backend", "gqa-8", "fp8-kv"],
+)
+def test_qwen3_5_config_selects_gluon_backend(
+    backend, heads, kv_cache_dtype, shuffle, expected, aiter_env
+):
+    from vllm.config import AttentionConfig
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.config import _default_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        pytest.skip("gfx950 only")
+    aiter_env(shuffle)
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        attention_config=AttentionConfig(
+            backend=AttentionBackendEnum[backend] if backend else None
+        ),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            get_num_attention_heads=lambda _: heads[0],
+            get_num_kv_heads=lambda _: heads[1],
+            get_head_size=lambda: 256,
+        ),
+        parallel_config=None,
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype),
+    )
+    _default_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon(config)
+    chosen = config.attention_config.backend
+    assert (chosen.name if chosen else None) == expected

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import vllm.config
+from tests.compile.backend import TestBackend
+from tests.v1.attention.utils import (
+    BatchSpec,
+    create_common_attn_metadata,
+    dense_kv_cache_views,
+)
+from vllm._aiter_ops import is_aiter_found_and_supported, rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.compilation.passes.fx_utils import find_op_nodes
+from vllm.config import (
+    CacheConfig,
+    CompilationConfig,
+    CompilationMode,
+    ModelConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, set_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec, KVCacheLayout
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+
+if not is_aiter_found_and_supported():
+    pytest.skip("ROCm with supported AITER is required", allow_module_level=True)
+
+if not rocm_aiter_ops.pa_decode_gluon_supports_output_gate():
+    pytest.skip("AITER pa_decode_gluon has no output_gate", allow_module_level=True)
+
+ATTN_OP = torch.ops.vllm.unified_attention_with_output.default
+
+
+class GatedAttentionModel(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Qwen3-Next gated attention: q and the gate interleaved per head."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_size, device):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
+        self.head_size = head_size
+        self.block_size = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+        self.device = device
+        self.layer_name = "model.layers.0.self_attn.attn"
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            num_heads=num_heads,
+            head_size=head_size,
+            scale=head_size**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=vllm_config.cache_config,
+            prefix=self.layer_name,
+            attn_backend=AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON.get_class(),
+        )
+        self.attn._k_scale = self.attn._k_scale.to(device)
+        self.attn._v_scale = self.attn._v_scale.to(device)
+        self.kv_cache_spec = self.attn.attn_backend.customize_spec(
+            AttentionSpec(
+                block_size=self.block_size,
+                num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
+                head_size=head_size,
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            )
+        )
+        self.builder = self.attn.attn_backend.get_builder_cls()(
+            kv_cache_spec=self.kv_cache_spec,
+            layer_names=[self.attn.layer_name],
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            device=device,
+        )
+
+    def build_attn_metadata(self, num_tokens: int, seq_len: int):
+        batch_spec = BatchSpec(
+            seq_lens=[seq_len] * num_tokens, query_lens=[1] * num_tokens
+        )
+        common = create_common_attn_metadata(
+            batch_spec, self.block_size, self.device, arange_block_indices=True
+        )
+        num_blocks = num_tokens * -(-seq_len // self.block_size)
+        raw = torch.zeros(
+            num_blocks * self.kv_cache_spec.page_size_bytes,
+            dtype=torch.int8,
+            device=self.device,
+        )
+        kv_cache = dense_kv_cache_views(
+            raw,
+            self.kv_cache_spec,
+            num_blocks,
+            num_layers=1,
+            layout=KVCacheLayout.LBHNC,
+        )[0]
+        generator = torch.Generator(device=self.device).manual_seed(1)
+        kv_cache.copy_(
+            torch.randn(
+                kv_cache.shape,
+                generator=generator,
+                dtype=kv_cache.dtype,
+                device=self.device,
+            )
+        )
+        self.attn.kv_cache = kv_cache
+        return self.builder.build(common_prefix_len=0, common_attn_metadata=common)
+
+    def forward(self, q_gate, k, v, gate_in_attention: bool = True, flat_gate=True):
+        q_gate = q_gate.view(-1, self.num_heads, 2 * self.head_size)
+        q, gate_by_head = torch.chunk(q_gate, 2, dim=-1)
+        gate = gate_by_head.reshape(-1, self.num_heads * self.head_size)
+        q = q.reshape(-1, self.num_heads * self.head_size)
+        if gate_in_attention:
+            return self.attn(q, k, v, output_gate=gate if flat_gate else gate_by_head)
+        return self.attn(q, k, v) * torch.sigmoid(gate)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [1, 7, 64, 128])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("seq_len", [37, 3000])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("gate_supported", [True, False], ids=["fused", "unsupported"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("flat_gate", [True, False], ids=["flat", "by_head"])
+def test_attention_output_gate(
+    num_tokens, seq_len, gate_supported, flat_gate, monkeypatch
+):
+    device = os.environ.get("VLLM_TEST_CUDA_DEVICE", "cuda")
+    torch.set_default_device(device)
+    torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_size = 24, 4, 256
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT", "1")
+    if not gate_supported:
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            rocm_aiter_ops, "pa_decode_gluon_supports_output_gate", lambda: False
+        )
+    rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(block_size=16),
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE),
+    )
+    with vllm.config.set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config):
+        model = GatedAttentionModel(
+            vllm_config, num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_size, device
+        )
+        backend = TestBackend()
+        q_gate = torch.randn(num_tokens, num_heads * 2 * head_size)
+        k = torch.randn(num_tokens, num_kv_heads * head_size)
+        v = torch.randn(num_tokens, num_kv_heads * head_size)
+
+        def run(fn, *args):
+            with set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+                attn_metadata = model.build_attn_metadata(num_tokens, seq_len)
+                forward_context = get_forward_context()
+                forward_context.attn_metadata = attn_metadata
+                forward_context.slot_mapping = {
+                    model.layer_name: attn_metadata.slot_mapping
+                }
+                return fn(q_gate.clone(), k.clone(), v.clone(), *args)
+
+        reference = run(model, False)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(q_gate, 0)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(k, 0)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(v, 0)
+        gated = run(torch.compile(model, backend=backend), True, flat_gate)
+

+"""ROCM_AITER_FA with single-token decodes on AITER's gluon paged attention."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_layers_from_vllm_config

+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import CommonAttentionMetadata, MultipleOf
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import (
+    AiterFlashAttentionBackend,
+    AiterFlashAttentionImpl,
+    AiterFlashAttentionMetadata,
+    AiterFlashAttentionMetadataBuilder,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec, is_quantized_kv_cache
+
+_HEAD_SIZE = 256
+_QUERY_GROUP_SIZES = (6,)
+_BLOCK_SIZE = 16
+_CONTEXT_PARTITION_SIZE = 128
+
+if current_platform.is_rocm():
+    from aiter.ops.triton.gluon.pa_decode_gluon import (
+        get_recommended_splits,
+        pa_decode_gluon,
+    )
+
+
+def pa_gluon_supports(
+    num_heads_q: int, num_heads_kv: int, head_size: int, kv_cache_dtype: str
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether a layer's head config and KV cache can use the gluon decode."""
+    return (
+        rocm_aiter_ops.is_shuffle_kv_cache_enabled()
+        and num_heads_kv > 0
+        and num_heads_q % num_heads_kv == 0
+        and num_heads_q // num_heads_kv in _QUERY_GROUP_SIZES
+        and head_size == _HEAD_SIZE
+        and not is_quantized_kv_cache(kv_cache_dtype)
+    )
+
+
+class AiterFlashAttentionGluonBackend(AiterFlashAttentionBackend):
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(kv_cache_spec=None) -> list[int | MultipleOf]:
+        return [_BLOCK_SIZE]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_impl_cls() -> type["AiterFlashAttentionGluonImpl"]:
+        return AiterFlashAttentionGluonImpl
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type["AiterFlashAttentionGluonMetadataBuilder"]:
+        return AiterFlashAttentionGluonMetadataBuilder
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_name() -> str:
+        return "ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON"
+
+
+class AiterFlashAttentionGluonMetadataBuilder(AiterFlashAttentionMetadataBuilder):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kv_cache_spec: AttentionSpec,
+        layer_names: list[str],
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device)
+        layers = get_layers_from_vllm_config(vllm_config, Attention)
+        self._gluon_layers = [
+            layers[name]
+            for name in layer_names
+            if name in layers and getattr(layers[name].impl, "use_gluon_decode", False)
+        ]
+
+    def _zero_null_block(self) -> None:
+        """Zero the null block: the gluon kernel reads masked V rows."""
+        blocks = [
+            layer.kv_cache[0]
+            for layer in self._gluon_layers
+            if isinstance(layer.kv_cache, torch.Tensor) and layer.kv_cache.numel() > 0
+        ]
+        if blocks:
+            torch._foreach_zero_(blocks)
+
+    def build(
+        self,
+        common_prefix_len: int,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        fast_build: bool = False,
+    ) -> AiterFlashAttentionMetadata:
+        metadata = super().build(common_prefix_len, common_attn_metadata, fast_build)
+        if metadata.num_decodes > 0:
+            self._zero_null_block()
+        return metadata
+
+    def build_for_drafting(
+        self,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        draft_index: int,
+    ) -> AiterFlashAttentionMetadata:
+        self._zero_null_block()
+        return super().build_for_drafting(common_attn_metadata, draft_index)
+
+
+class AiterFlashAttentionGluonImpl(AiterFlashAttentionImpl):
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.use_gluon_decode = (
+            pa_gluon_supports(
+                self.num_heads, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size, self.kv_cache_dtype
+            )
+            and self.sliding_window[0] == -1
+            and self.sinks is None
+            and self.alibi_slopes is None
+        )
+        self._output_gate: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._gated_tokens = 0
+
+    def fused_output_gate_supported(self) -> bool:
+        return self.use_gluon_decode and bool(
+            rocm_aiter_ops.pa_decode_gluon_supports_output_gate()
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor | None,
+        value: torch.Tensor | None,
+        kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_metadata: AiterFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+        output_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        output_block_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        output_gate: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """output_gate: [num_tokens, num_heads, head_size]; when set, output is
+        attention * sigmoid(output_gate)."""
+        self._output_gate, self._gated_tokens = output_gate, 0
+        try:
+            super().forward(
+                layer,
+                query,
+                key,
+                value,
+                kv_cache,
+                attn_metadata,
+                output=output,
+                output_scale=output_scale,
+                output_block_scale=output_block_scale,
+            )
+        finally:
+            self._output_gate = None
+        if output_gate is not None and attn_metadata is not None:
+            start, end = self._gated_tokens, attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
+            if start < end:
+                output[start:end].mul_(torch.sigmoid(output_gate[start:end]))
+        return output

+    def _decode_shuffle_layout(

+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        value_cache: torch.Tensor,

+            not self.use_gluon_decode
+            or block_size != _BLOCK_SIZE
+            or num_decode_tokens != num_decodes
+        ):
+            super()._decode_shuffle_layout(
+                layer,
+                query,
+                key_cache,
+                value_cache,
+                output,
+                attn_metadata,
+                num_decodes,
+                num_decode_tokens,
+            )
+            return
+        num_heads = query.shape[1]
+        x = 16 // key_cache.element_size()
+        splits = get_recommended_splits(num_decodes, num_kv_heads)
+        gate_kwargs = {}
+        if self._output_gate is not None and splits > 1:
+            gate_kwargs["output_gate"] = self._output_gate[:num_decode_tokens]
+        partial_shape = (num_decodes, num_kv_heads, splits, num_heads // num_kv_heads)
+        exp_sums = torch.empty(partial_shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
+        pa_decode_gluon(
+            output=output[:num_decode_tokens],
+            query=query[:num_decode_tokens],
+            key_cache=key_cache.reshape(
+                num_blocks, num_kv_heads, head_size // x, block_size, x
+            ),
+            value_cache=value_cache.reshape(
+                num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size // x, head_size, x
+            ),
+            context_lengths=attn_metadata.seq_lens[:num_decodes].to(torch.int32),
+            block_tables=attn_metadata.block_table[:num_decodes].to(torch.int32),
+            softmax_scale=self.scale,
+            query_length=1,
+            max_context_partition_num=splits,
+            context_partition_size=_CONTEXT_PARTITION_SIZE,
+            compute_type=query.dtype,
+            query_scale=None,
+            key_scale=None,
+            value_scale=None,
+            exp_sums=exp_sums,
+            max_logits=torch.empty_like(exp_sums),
+            temporary_output=torch.empty(
+                (*partial_shape, head_size), dtype=output.dtype, device=query.device
+            ),
+            alibi_slopes=None,
+            sinks=None,
+            sliding_window=0,
+            ps=True,
+            **gate_kwargs,
+        )
+        if gate_kwargs:
+            self._gated_tokens = num_decode_tokens
